reason: Conversation 2 correctly routed escalation through the landlord/letting agent (the right channel for a rented integrated unit), gave sensible food-safety advice, bundled the key checks efficiently, and offered a low-cost test (dial up one step, monitor 12-24h) while staying honest that the cause (fan/damper vs cooling/control) can't be pinned down remotely without naming a part. Conversation 1 was slow and repetitive (re-asking about vents the customer had already checked, misreading 'running a lot' as fan noise), never mentioned the landlord route, and drifted to 'sealed cooling system' as the most likely area on thin evidence. Conversation 2's opening 'switch it off and unplug it' was an unnecessary and self-contradictory instruction for a fridge being monitored, and neither conversation asked for the model from the inside label or proposed a full defrost, but overall 2 was more useful and better targeted.
